title: Subgroup Analysis & Heterogeneous Treatment Effects
description: Heterogeneous effects, Simpson's paradox, and segment-level multiple comparisons are where ambitious experiment analyses go wrong. Build the discipline to detect real subgroup effects without fooling yourself.
outcomes: You'll run honest segment analyses without inflating false positives, recognise Simpson's paradox in real experiment outputs, separate novelty effects from genuine heterogeneous treatment effects, and analyse spillover-prone geo experiments correctly.
